reasons.layout: Blank lines, compact getters and readonly sorting fields versus private fields/getters differ. They are not wire behavior; every byte remains snapshot-gated rather than formatting-normalized.
reasons.imports: TypeScript marks type-only imports explicitly and orders/merges imports differently. This supports verbatimModuleSyntax without changing runtime constructors. .NET output needs normal type-import elision.
reasons.command-suppression: The .NET command hook contains a ts-ignore comment. TypeScript does not need that suppression with the pinned browser client; both public signatures are checked independently.
reasons.query-source: The .NET provenance source identifies the read-model type; TypeScript identifies the query method as well. Only the timestamp is variable-normalized; source and body hash remain gated.
reasons.sorting: For this parameterized model-bound query .NET 22.45.0 emits sortBy.id from the query input. TypeScript emits sortBy.name/detail/notice/status from the result model. Preserve result-oriented TypeScript sorting instead of copying the .NET behavior; this is an intentional API difference, not parity.
reasons.enum-names: .NET camel-cases enum members to draft/published. TypeScript preserves source names Draft/Published. Numeric wire values 0/1 and numeric hydration agree, so changing source names would be an unnecessary API break.
reasons.barrel-ownership: TypeScript marks the barrel with a provenance/body-hash header for safe owned-file regeneration. The .NET barrel is unmarked. Exports are identical; destructive .NET cleanup is not adopted.
